variants.name: TimberProp
variants.collider: 3 box colliders: post (tilted, follow the kink roughly), crossbeam, brace; or one convex per part
variants.notes: Modelled: kinked post, plinth, crossbeam, brace, 4 wedges, cracks (V-grooves) and chipped edges on all beams, X lashing + 2 bands, knot with 2 loose ends, brace-head lashing with tail, 2 iron straps + iron plate with nails, 4 pegs, nailed patch over a hole, loose/bent nails, splinters, earth heaped on the plinth, clods/pebbles/chips/shavings/needles/dry leaves around the base. Grain/rope fibres painted. Beam top ~2.9 m.
